You wake up. And there's a health bar floating above your head.
You rub your eyes. It's still there. Your mom calls from the kitchen. Breakfast is ready!
You go downstairs. She says it again. Breakfast is ready! Same voice. Same smile.
Outside, your neighbor waters the same flower. Over. And over.
Then a box pops up right in front of your face.

text: Quest one. Survive the school day.

You take one step, trip on the stairs, and one heart disappears.

text: And a voice whispers. Two lives left.
